purpose: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on upstream antirez ds4 (Q2 GGUF, SSD-streamed experts and Engram), 1,048,576 aggregate context as 4 batched sessions x 262,144 (owner default 2026-09-26). Switch alias dsv41flash through the generic profile path. Never the default until its gates pass.

status.basis: Not yet servable: the switch refuses estimated profiles, so DeepSeek V4 stays the default. Measured so far (diagnostic only): the ds4 CLI text smoke at ctx 8192 with a 42 GB expert cache (results/dsv41-flash-gates/smoke-2026-09-25/). A 48 GB cache reproducibly logs NVRM NV_ERR_NO_MEMORY, so 42 GB is the measured-clean cap. The ds4-server launch, the direct-1M gate and the qualification kit have not run.

safety.note: 10 GiB whole-host floor per the AGENTS.md 1M gate. CUDA allocations on GB10 (the expert cache and pinned staging) are NOT charged to the memory cgroup, so MemoryHigh/MemoryMax bound only host-side pages; the external memwatch MemAvailable kill floor is the binding control.

memory_model.basis: ds4 planned-memory line at ctx 8192 with --ssd-streaming-cache-experts 42gb: KV 0.06 GiB + buffers 3.23 GiB + resident model 9.37 GiB + expert cache 34.87 GiB + prefill expert reserve 7.12 GiB = 54.65 GiB planned. overhead_gib = buffers + expert cache + prefill reserve. kv_bytes_per_token is the ~890 B/token compressed global KV; the 0.06 GiB at 8K also holds fixed local-window state. With 4 batched sessions x 262,144 (shared prefill workspace), KV and any context-scaled buffers are estimates until the direct-1M gate measures them. Routed experts and the 188.8 GiB Engram tables stream from disk and are not resident.
